messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT triggered: GPU pool saturation in us-west-2 for inference-dedicated. Severity: P1. Affected customers: 3 tenants seeing elevated latencies. Pager: Olivia

sre-bot: Auto-runbooks triggered: runbook 'gpu-pressure/fallback' started. Expected mitigation window 10-15m. Notifying infra-scaling.

Olivia: acked. joining bridge now -> https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/2117001234 :phone:

Matt: I'm on the bridge too, pulling autoscaler metrics. Initial observation: one pool (infradp-west-2-a) dropped node count due to quota errors, requests queued.

Anya: seeing 504 spikes from the EU gateway too, looks like cross-region routing moved load into us-west-2 after eu nodes hit limits.

Leo: oncall HCI, coming in to help with pool adjustments, what's the immediate ask?

Olivia: need short-term capacity to drain queues and then a safe rollback to stable config. If we can add 4 GPUs to infradp-west-2-a ASAP, that should buy us time.

James: I'm opening a temporary burst capacity request with cloud team (ticket #CLD-4621). ETA ~8m.

Matt: while that happens, I'm going to increase autoscaler target from 30 -> 50 for the pool so it can scale up quicker and avoid oversubscribe. Will run `kubectl patch` now.

Matt: ```bash
kubectl -n infra patch hpa/inference-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":50}}'
```

Olivia: noted. please monitor token throughput and tail latencies. set an alert if p95 > 800ms.

Anya: adding p95 alert. Command: `opsctl alert create --name gpu-p95 --thresh 800 --scope us-west-2`

sre-bot: Update: cloud ticket CLD-4621 provisioned 4 GPUs to infradp-west-2-a, nodes joining cluster. Autoscaler increased. Queue length decreasing.

Caitlin: Customer success ping: Tenant acme-inc reports degraded latency in last 30m. They're asking for ETA to recovery. Any timeline?

Olivia: telling CS: we expect traffic normalizing in 10-20 minutes while we allow autoscaler and burst nodes to drain queue. Will follow up after recovery.

Matt: metrics show token/sec down from peak and retries trickling down. p95 currently 1.2s but trending down.

Leo: I see a misconfigured quota check in our autoscaler webhook that caused a reconcile failure earlier. I can patch webhook to ignore transient quota error 429s for 5m to prevent thrashing. Should I proceed?

Olivia: yes, patch and we can revert after stabilization. Document patch in the post-incident notes.

Leo: ```yaml
# patch to webhook to tolerate transient quota errors
webhook:
  retryPolicy:
    transientStatusCodes: [429]
    backoffSeconds: 5
    tolerateWindow: 300
```

sre-bot: Webhook patched successfully. Recording action in incident timeline.

James: cloud reports nodes now fully healthy and serving. Queue drained. p95 down to 420ms. CS updated.

Caitlin: Acme-inc replied: "Thanks, latency is back to acceptable levels. Please keep us posted about root cause."

Olivia: cool, let's do immediate post-incident next steps: 1) schedule postmortem 2) assign remediation tickets 3) confirm capacity guardrails. Who can own the remediation thread?

Matt: I can own investigating autoscaler webhook bug and a follow-up fix.

Leo: I'll take ownership of capacity guardrails and the short-term runbook update (increase maxReplicas safe limit guidance).

Anya: I'll work with CS to capture customer impact windows and create the traffic replay for regression tests.

Olivia: great. Let's create JIRA tickets now so nothing slips.

Olivia: JIRA created: INFRA-914 (postmortem writeup) assigned to Olivia, due EOD tomorrow.

Matt: JIRA created: INFRA-915 (autoscaler webhook root cause + fix) assigned to Matt, due in 3 working days. Checklist: reproduce locally, add unit test for quota handling, deploy canary.

Leo: JIRA created: INFRA-916 (capacity guardrails + runbook updates) assigned to Leo, due in 5 working days. Includes: set min/burst quotas, document manual burst path, test autoscaler tolerances.

Anya: JIRA created: CS-1023 (customer impact summary for Acme-inc & BetaCorp) assigned to Anya, due EOD today.

Olivia: Timings and action items:
- INFRA-914 (Olivia) due 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC
- INFRA-915 (Matt) due 2026-03-19 17:00 UTC
- INFRA-916 (Leo) due 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC
- CS-1023 (Anya) due 2026-03-15 23:59 UTC

Matt: quick note for postmortem: include K8s controller logs from 2026-03-15 02:05:00 -> 02:30:00 UTC and the autoscaler webhook metrics. I'll attach logs to INFRA-915.

Leo: suggested follow-up mitigation (short-term): add a thin-provisioning pool that can be used for sudden bursts with pre-warmed LRM images. Will spec in INFRA-916.

Caitlin: CS will send templated customer notes after postmortem is published. Ask: does Acme want a review call?

Olivia: let's offer a short 15m recap call. Anya, can you coordinate with Acme?

Anya: yes, I'll offer times and cc Caitlin.

sre-bot: Incident state: resolved -> recovered. Duration: ~38 minutes from initial trigger to full drain. Timeline recorded to INFRA-914.

pagerduty-bot: Incident closed by Olivia. Pager duty notes saved.

Olivia: postmortem meeting scheduled: 2026-03-16 10:30 UTC (calendar invite sent). Please bring logs, timeline, and proposed remediation.

Matt: I'll prepare a short demo of repro and test plan.

Leo: I'll draft runbook updates and a validation script: `scripts/check-autoscaler-tolerances.sh` to run as a preflight.

James: follow-up: Cloud quota team suggested we request a permanent bump for the pool to avoid recurring manual bursts. I'll open ticket CLD-4621-bump and link to INFRA-916.

Olivia: final action: owners, due dates recorded. I'll write initial postmortem skeleton and assign sections. Thanks all for fast response. :white_check_mark:

Caitlin: thanks team. I'll wait for postmortem to send customer note and schedule call if requested.

Olivia: closing bridge. if anything else shows up, re-open thread. Good job.
